cohort: 113 pregnancies achieved through assisted reproductive treatment in women with endometriosis, matched with controls who conceived through assisted reproductive treatment due to male infertility
finding: Women with endometriosis experienced higher rates of various obstetric complications, including first-trimester bleeding, pre-eclampsia, premature delivery threat, pelvic pain, and cesarean section, with deep endometriosis and advanced stages (rAFS III-IV) specifically linked to IUGR.
mod_finding: Cesarean section rates were higher in women with endometriosis.
birth_weight: Smaller in infants of mothers with endometriosis
